name: phi-manage
description: Automates Intel TCI (tcitools.intel.com) PHI forecast report extraction, filtering, WIF generation, and email delivery for any product CommonName. Supports SDA Weekly/Monthly, MOR Spread, MOR Forecasts, and ENG reports with client-side operation/class/yield/burn-in filtering, DLCP post-filtering with fallback, time-column relabeling, and formatted xlsx output via Excel COM + Outlook COM email.
author: YYANG71
